name: dify
description: 查找并运行你的 Dify 应用，管理插件、模型供应商和工具凭据。支持 Dify Cloud 和私有部署，连接时填写 Dify 地址和个人访问令牌
description_zh: 查找并运行你的 Dify 应用，管理插件、模型供应商和工具凭据。支持 Dify Cloud 和私有部署，连接时填写 Dify 地址和个人访问令牌
description_en: Find and run your Dify apps, and manage plugins, model providers and tool credentials. Works with Dify Cloud and self-hosted Dify: enter your Dify host and a personal access token to connect.
